note: United States: All 63 national parks with a full guide, and 4,994 more places on the map: other NPS units from the NPS Data API; every state park from PAD-US; every national forest, grassland and wildlife refuge, the BLM's monuments and conservation areas, National Natural Landmarks and scenic byways from their agencies' own data. Guide prose is written for Unigrids; descriptions, fees, hours, visitor centres and photographs are the NPS's own; places with no agency prose carry a lead adapted from Wikipedia, credited where it is shown. Japan: all 35 national parks with a guide, their areas and designation years from the Ministry of the Environment's national park table, outlines from its zone file and 2024 visitors from its statistics; and 58 quasi-national parks from the Ministry's list, outlined from OpenStreetMap where it maps them and otherwise shown as a point, with leads adapted from Wikipedia. Prefectures from Natural Earth; huts and rail from OpenStreetMap; photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited individually. Norway: all 48 national parks with a guide, 195 landscape protection areas and 230 nature reserves of 10 km² or more, from Miljødirektoratet's Naturvernområder (NLOD 2.0; outlines simplified by Unigrids) and Kartverket's counties (CC BY 4.0). Guide prose is written for Unigrids; huts, rail lines and stations are from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); photographs are from Wikimedia Commons, each with its own credit and licence; places without a guide carry a lead adapted from Wikipedia where one exists, credited where it is shown.
